-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Unnamed crystal blade.png  |title= Crystal Magic |kanji= 水晶魔法 |romaji= Suishō Mahō |english= Crystal Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Rick Cornell }} {{Nihongo|Crystal Magic|水晶魔法|Suishō Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate crystals.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate crystals at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.{{Clr}}
